{{Top|leg}}
{{Conjecture|legends}}
A '''sector council''' administered the [[Barsa sector/Legends|Barsa sector]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. When local [[Sector/Legends|sector]] observers discovered that the [[Ubese/Legends|Ubese]] [[Species/Legends|species]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Uba IV/Legends|Uba IV]] was manufacturing weapons that had been banned since the formation of the Republic, the sector council decided to conduct a preemptive strike to prevent the Ubese from becoming a major threat. However, the [[Bombardment of the Uba system|orbital strike]] that followed set off many of the Ubese large-scale tactical weapons, ravaging several planets in the [[Uba system/Legends|Uba system]].
